recommendation.rationale: Current lifecycle source plus independent Windows rerun support assignment-before-gate, isolated A/B Job membership, kill-on-last-handle-close, and cleanup for the trusted synthetic fixture.
nonBlockingObservations: The output fields assigned_before_gate=true and original_owner_assigned=false are literals rather than values derived from explicit assertions. The call order and exact membership assertions support the constrained fixture result, but those two fields are not independent measurements.

OwnedJob.assign uses CPython Popen._handle, a private handle field; suitable for this prototype run, but a product implementation should pin/test the Python contract or use an explicit stable process-handle abstraction.

watch_member queries Job PIDs and then calls OpenProcess(SYNCHRONIZE); the retained HANDLE prevents later PID reuse from changing waits, though a query-to-open race remains. The persistent trusted fixture and absence of security claims keep this non-blocking here.

lifecycleReview.finding: Creates a private Job handle, sets only JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE (0x2000), and closes the owned handle idempotently.

Starts the trusted gate with a replacement environment; waits for its ready event; assigns the Popen process HANDLE; verifies initial membership is exactly that child; only then writes the gate command. Failure closes the Job and kills/waits the direct child.
Gate emits ready and waits for one trusted stdin command before importing the optional driver or spawning the fixture child.
Synthetic fixture spawns one persistent leaf; the driver path is imported only after assignment gate opens.

Confirms each Job contains exactly its own gate and reported leaf; retains SYNCHRONIZE handles; closes A and waits for both A processes, observes both B handles still alive, then closes B and waits for both B processes.
Finally path stops each owned Job, closes retained handles, persists per-child stdout/stderr and summary, and exits nonzero if run status is not passed.

Current-source harness changes add Git to the child PATH and capture driver arguments with argparse.REMAINDER; generic lifecycle path remains unchanged. Module/driver execution branch is out of review scope.

observedLimitations: Windows host and trusted fixture only; no malicious process, filesystem, network, API, credential, or general OS sandbox property established.
Closing the Job forcibly terminates members; it is not cooperative cancellation, checkpoint flush, or durable recovery.
Actual DSH SDK-under-Job execution is outside this review and NOT_RUN here.
Assignment compatibility depends on the host process/job hierarchy and Windows behavior; this single host run does not prove all supported OS/host configurations.

officialReferences.supports: AssignProcessToJobObject consumes Job and process HANDLEs; assigned process is subject to Job limits; nested-job/host compatibility has constraints.
Job Objects group processes; child processes join by default; closing the last Job handle with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE terminates associated processes.
Extended-limit structure layout used by the ctypes declaration.
